description: ⚠️ Destructive: Revoke an Advanced certificate (or the whole order with certificateNo=0) (Certificate Manager 2.0). Set confirm=true to execute. Public zone only. Works with main-account and Sub Account keys (Sub Account verified 2026-11-25; earlier the 2.0 API rejected Sub Account keys with HTTP 403).

certificateNo.description: Certificate number; 0 revokes every certificate in the order

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute the destructive operation

name: ncloud_cm2_revoke_certificate
